headword.ipa: /ˈɡɒθəm/ (fictional city and New York nickname); /ˈɡəʊtəm/ (English village)

morphology.pattern_note: 作为外语专名整体记忆，规范书写为 Gotham；不作马来语词缀分析。is_root 沿用输入分类，不表示已经确认为马来语词根。

senses.zh_definition: 哥谭市：DC 蝙蝠侠故事中的虚构城市。
senses.en_definition: The fictional city that serves as Batman's principal base of operations.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi bandar rekaan yang menjadi tempat utama Batman beroperasi dalam cerita terbitan DC.
senses.nuances: 属于地名专名，规范形式为 Gotham 或 Gotham City。输入没有提供 DBP 释义，无法据此标为 official；本条马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 原文。排名仅保留输入值，未验证其语料来源。以下搭配为自然用法示例，未作频率统计。[DC 官方人物介绍](https://www.dc.com/characters/batman)

senses.zh_definition: 哥谭：美国纽约市的文学性别称。
senses.en_definition: A literary nickname for New York City.
senses.ms_definition: Nama julukan sastera bagi bandar raya New York.
senses.nuances: 与蝙蝠侠故事中的虚构城市须按上下文区分。这一别称与华盛顿·欧文的作品有关。[Gotham 教区议会历史介绍](https://gothamparishcouncil.org.uk/parish-history/)

senses.zh_definition: Gotham：英国诺丁汉郡的一座村庄及同名民政教区。
senses.en_definition: A village and civil parish in Nottinghamshire, England.
senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah kampung dan paroki awam di Nottinghamshire, England.
senses.nuances: 当地村名的读音通常接近 GOAT-em，区别于蝙蝠侠城市名中的 /θ/。该专名不宜套用马来语逐字母读音。[诺丁汉郡旅游机构介绍](https://www.visit-nottinghamshire.co.uk/explore/rural-nottinghamshire/rural-towns-and-villages/gotham)

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran tersebut menampilkan gambaran bandar Gotham dalam komik Batman.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览展示了蝙蝠侠漫画中的哥谭市形象。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition presents depictions of Gotham City in Batman comics.

etymology.historical_story: Gotham has a real English village behind its fictional fame. Tales about the village's supposedly foolish inhabitants travelled widely, and Washington Irving used Gotham as a nickname for New York. Batman readers later encountered Gotham as a fictional city. The village and the comic-book city have different conventional pronunciations. [Village history](https://gothamparishcouncil.org.uk/parish-history/), [DC](https://www.dc.com/characters/batman).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Gotham，先联想 Batman 的哥谭市；遇到英国村名，再切换为近似 GOAT-em 的读音。
